comment:
* A padder that adds Trailing-Bit-Compliment padding to a block. *

* This padding pads the block out with the compliment of the last bit * of the plain text. *

* @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public void init(SecureRandom random) throws IllegalArgumentException
methods.comment:
* Initialise the padder.
     *
     * @param random - a SecureRandom if available.

methods.name: public String getPaddingName()
methods.comment:
* Return the name of the algorithm the padder implements.
     *
     * @return the name of the algorithm the padder implements.

methods.name: public int addPadding(byte[] in, int inOff)
methods.comment:
* add the pad bytes to the passed in block, returning the * number of bytes added. *

* Note: this assumes that the last block of plain text is always * passed to it inside in. i.e. if inOff is zero, indicating the * entire block is to be overwritten with padding the value of in * should be the same as the last block of plain text. *

methods.name: public int padCount(byte[] in) throws InvalidCipherTextException
methods.comment: * return the number of pad bytes present in the block.

methodNames: public void init(SecureRandom random) throws IllegalArgumentException
public int addPadding(byte[] in, int inOff)
public int padCount(byte[] in) throws InvalidCipherTextException
